title: First pulsar discovered
summary: As a PhD student, Bell noticed a regular radio signal in her chart data and persisted against doubts that it was interference. It was the first known pulsar.
why: Opened the study of neutron stars, collapsed stellar cores.

unsung.contribution: Spotted and pursued the anomalous radio signal that proved to be the first known pulsar.
unsung.recognition: The 1974 Nobel Prize in Physics recognised the discovery, but she was not among its recipients.
